user.title: Menstruation Cycle
user.description: Create a profile (username + friendly name) for cycle tracking.

data_description.dashboard_enabled: Adds an optional dedicated Cycle Dashboard page to the Home Assistant sidebar. Can be changed later in the options.
data_description.copy_settings_from: Reuses another profile's shared preferences (notify target/lead times, NFP mode, temperature unit, visibility level, calendar toggle) as a starting point. Leave empty to start from scratch. Does not copy anything person-specific such as the linked person or the cycle length override.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure profile
reconfigure.description: Update this profile's display name, icon, or onboarding stage. For all other settings (notifications, visibility, life stages, ...), use the integration's Configure/Options dialog instead.

error.invalid_profile: Profile must contain letters or numbers.

init.title: Menstruation Cycle Settings
init.description: General settings. Enable any life stages below to configure their details on the next screen(s).

data.birth_date: Birth date (YYYY-MM-DD, optional — enables age display and improves pre-menarche mode)

data_description.period_duration_days: Number of days the period typically lasts (1–14).
data_description.cycle_length_override: Override the automatically calculated average cycle length. Set to 0 to use the auto-calculated value from your history (recommended). Set to 20–38 to manually fix the cycle length used for fertile window and ovulation calculations.
data_description.num_predictions: How many future cycle starts to generate (1–12). Default is 6.
data_description.onboarding_stage: Choose pre-menarche, early menarche learning phase, or established cycle.
data_description.dashboard_enabled: Adds an optional dedicated Cycle Dashboard page to the Home Assistant sidebar.
data_description.calendar_enabled: Creates a native calendar.profile_cycle entity with predicted period, fertile window and ovulation events, usable in Home Assistant's own Calendar dashboard and calendar.* automation triggers. Disable if you don't need it - the same events remain available via the separate ICS feed export.
data_description.calendar_pregnancy_events: Adds the calculated due date as an all-day event to the cycle calendar and the ICS feed. Off by default - the ICS feed is shared via its token (e.g. with a partner's calendar).
data_description.calendar_contraception_events: Adds renewal dates (IUD, implant, injection), the end of the pill pack and the next patch/ring steps to the cycle calendar and the ICS feed. Off by default - the ICS feed is shared via its token (e.g. with a partner's calendar).
data_description.calendar_logged_periods: Shows your logged periods (the last 12 months) as events in the cycle calendar and the ICS feed, not only the predictions. Off by default - the ICS feed is shared via its token (e.g. with a partner's calendar).
data_description.nfp_analysis_mode: Controls how ovulation and the fertile window are calculated. 'hybrid' (default) learns from observed temperature data and falls back to the statistical formula. 'strict' only shows ovulation and the fertile window when a temperature rise is confirmed in the current cycle.
data_description.visibility_level: Controls how much of this profile's data appears in sensor attributes (dashboards, cards, and the companion app's overview screens). 'Full' (default) shows everything as before. 'Status only' shows just coarse, prediction-near values (next period / current phase), no symptom or health details. 'Private' shows almost nothing beyond the fact that the profile exists. Applies only to sensor attributes — services called directly (e.g. get_full_history) are unaffected, since the integration has no way to distinguish which device or person is calling.

notifications.name: Notifications
notifications.description: When and where reminders are sent.

data.notify_overdue_enabled: Notify when the period is overdue
data.notify_checkup_enabled: Notify before a checkup is due
data.notify_fertile_mute_hormonal: No fertility notifications on hormonal contraception
data.notify_cycle_hint: Hint for an unusual cycle length

data_description.notifications_enabled: Sends a notification when the period is predicted to start tomorrow, or when the fertile window starts today.
data_description.notify_service: Home Assistant notify target to use. Leave empty to use a persistent notification (shown in the HA UI) by default.
data_description.notify_partner_service: Optional second notify target (e.g. a partner's phone) that receives only the date reminders - period, fertile window and ovulation - never badges, symptoms or other health details. Nothing is sent at visibility level 'Private'; fertile window and ovulation are only sent at 'Full'. Leave empty to turn off.
data_description.notify_time: Time of day at which period, fertile window, ovulation and badge notifications are sent (default 08:00). Previously these were sent right after midnight. Takes effect as soon as the settings are saved.
data_description.notify_period_enabled: Sends a notification a configurable number of days before the period is predicted to start. Requires 'Enable notifications' above.
data_description.notify_period_lead_days: How many days ahead of the predicted period start to notify (0–7). 1 (default) means the day before, 0 means the same day.
data_description.notify_fertile_enabled: Sends a notification a configurable number of days before the fertile window is predicted to start. Requires 'Enable notifications' above.
data_description.notify_fertile_lead_days: How many days ahead of the predicted fertile window start to notify (0–7). 0 (default) means the same day.
data_description.notify_ovulation_enabled: Sends a notification a configurable number of days before the estimated ovulation day. Off by default. Requires 'Enable notifications' above.
data_description.notify_ovulation_lead_days: How many days ahead of the estimated ovulation day to notify (0–7). 0 (default) means the same day.
data_description.notify_log_reminder_enabled: Sends a reminder when nothing (cycle start or symptoms) is logged for today yet. Off by default. Requires 'Enable notifications' above.
data_description.notify_log_reminder_time: Time of day for the evening log reminder (default 20:00).
data_description.notify_recap_enabled: Sends a short recap (cycle length and period duration, compared with the average, plus pain days) once a new cycle start has been logged. Goes only to this profile's own notification target. Off by default. Requires 'Enable notifications' above.
data_description.notify_overdue_enabled: Sends one notification once the period is 7 days past its predicted start and not logged (same threshold as the repair hint), with a 'Period started' button. Not sent while predictions are still low-confidence. Goes only to this profile's own target. Off by default. Requires 'Enable notifications' above.
data_description.notify_checkup_enabled: Sends one notification 14 days before the next checkup is due (last logged checkup plus the checkup interval below), or once if it is already overdue. Needs a checkup interval above 0. Off by default. Requires 'Enable notifications' above.
data_description.notify_fertile_mute_hormonal: Skips the fertile-window and ovulation notifications while the current contraception method is hormonal (pill, hormonal IUD, implant, patch, ring, injection), since the cycle is usually suppressed then. The sensor state and the dashboard stay unchanged. Off by default.
data_description.notify_unprotected_hint: When unprotected intercourse is logged for today or one of the last 5 days, sends one neutral hint: if a pregnancy is not wanted, a pharmacy or doctor can advise on emergency contraception, and the sooner the better. No dosing, no medical advice. Not sent during pregnancy or menopause. Off by default. Requires 'Enable notifications' above.
data_description.notify_pregnancy_updates: While pregnancy mode is on, sends a short neutral message once a week (on the weekday of the pregnancy start) with the current week, and a note at the start of the 2nd and 3rd trimester. No medical advice.
data_description.notify_cycle_hint: After a new period start, sends one neutral hint when the last three cycles were all shorter than 21 or all longer than 38 days, or when the last cycle was 10 or more days off your average. It is no diagnosis; it only suggests mentioning it at the next check-up.
data_description.notify_test_hint: After an ovulation that was confirmed by your temperature and mucus/cervix logs, sends one neutral message 14 days later: a pregnancy test is meaningful from about now. It is only a rule of thumb, no medical advice. Skipped while pregnant and on hormonal contraception if the fertility notifications are muted for it. Off by default.

pill.name: Pill reminder
pill.description: Daily pill reminder, follow-up and pack break.

data.notify_pill_gap_enabled: Hint when pill intakes are missing

data_description.notify_pill_enabled: Sends a daily reminder with a 'Pill taken' button (mobile app targets) while the pill is the profile's current contraception method. Tapping the button logs today's intake, and no reminder is sent once today's pill is logged. For a patch or ring it reminds on the steps of the usual 28-day rhythm instead (change, remove, new pack), with a 'Started today' button on new-pack days. Off by default. Requires 'Enable notifications' above.
data_description.notify_pill_time: Time of day for the pill reminder (default 09:00).
data_description.notify_pill_followup_hours: Hours after the pill reminder for a second reminder if today's pill is still not logged. 0 = off (default, max 12; skipped if it would fall after midnight).
data_description.pill_pause_days: Days without pills between packs (e.g. 7 for 21/7, 4 for 24/4). No pill reminder is sent during that break, which is recognised after a run of at least 21 logged pill days. 0 = continuous use, no break (default, max 7).
data_description.notify_pill_gap_enabled: Extends the pill reminder with a neutral hint once 2 or more days in a row have no logged intake: protection may be reduced if pills were missed, see the leaflet. Needs a pack break set above (or a gap of more than 7 days) so a normal break is not mistaken for forgotten pills. Off by default. Requires the pill reminder.

tracking.name: Tracking & integrations
tracking.description: Temperature unit, linked sensors and checkup reminder.

data_description.temperature_unit: Which unit basal_temp values are interpreted in when logged via the log_symptoms/add_symptom service. Storage and the basal-temperature sensor always stay in Celsius — Home Assistant automatically displays it in the unit your HA instance is configured for.
data_description.basal_temp_sensor_entity_id: Optional temperature sensor (e.g. a smart thermometer). Its reading is imported as today's basal temperature when the integration starts and at midnight; a value you logged yourself is never overwritten.
data_description.checkup_interval_months: Months after the last logged gynecologist/pap smear appointment before a repair hint suggests a routine checkup. 0 = off (default 12). Only applies to profiles that logged such an appointment.
data_description.linked_person_entity_id: Link this profile to an existing person (Settings → People). If that person has a picture, the companion app can show it as the profile picture.

life_stages.name: Life stages
life_stages.description: Switch on a life stage to configure it in the next step.

data_description.pregnancy_enabled: Activates pregnancy tracking mode and shows a details screen next.
data_description.pre_menarche_enabled: Track puberty signs before the first period (menarche) and shows a details screen next.
data_description.menopause_enabled: Activates menopause tracking mode and shows a details screen next.
data_description.postpartum_enabled: Activates postpartum tracking mode and shows a details screen next.

data.pregnancy_risk_notes: Risk notes (optional, e.g. condition or monitoring focus)

data_description.pregnancy_start_date: First day of last menstruation (LMP). Leave empty to use the last recorded cycle start.

data_description.family_menarche_age: Age of menarche in the family (mother/sister) used to estimate the expected age.

data_description.menopause_start_date: Date when menopause started (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave empty if unknown.

data_description.postpartum_start_date: Date the baby was born. Used to calculate the postpartum tracking window.
data_description.postpartum_duration_days: How many days after birth to stay in postpartum mode (1–365). Default is 42 (6 weeks).

confirm.title: Review and confirm

error.invalid_date: Invalid date format. Please use YYYY-MM-DD.
error.invalid_menarche_age: Age must be a number between 8 and 20.
error.invalid_cycle_length_override: Cycle length must be a number between 20 and 38, or 0 to use automatic calculation.

log_product_usage.name: Log product usage
log_product_usage.description: Log period-product usage for timer integrations and long-term statistics.

action.name: Action
action.description: Usage action, for example used or emptied.

quantity.name: Quantity
quantity.description: How many products or emptying events to add.

date.name: Date
date.description: Optional ISO date to backfill. Defaults to today.

area_id.name: Area
area_id.description: Home Assistant area the stock or usage belongs to.

reimport_basal_temp_statistics.name: Re-import basal temperature statistics
reimport_basal_temp_statistics.description: Force a fresh import of historical basal-temperature readings into Home Assistant's long-term statistics. Normally runs once automatically; use this to retry if an earlier attempt found nothing.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Target basal-temperature or menstruation gauge sensor.

get_full_history.name: Get full history
get_full_history.description: Retrieve the complete, uncompacted symptom history (and product usage) for a profile, bounded to a number of recent days. Bypasses the sensor's attribute size limits, which can drop symptom_history entirely under heavy tracking history.

days.name: Days
days.description: How many recent days to include (1-730). Defaults to 180.

get_cycle_predictions.name: Get cycle predictions
get_cycle_predictions.description: Retrieve fertile window and ovulation day estimates for past and future cycles, not just the current one — the same per-cycle estimate the calendar card already shows for every cycle displayed.

days_back.name: Days back
days_back.description: How many days of past cycles to include (1-1825). Defaults to 365.

future_cycles.name: Future cycles
future_cycles.description: How many future cycles to project forward (0-24). Defaults to 3.

export_full_backup.name: Export full backup (all profiles)
export_full_backup.description: Write a single JSON file containing the complete stored data (history, symptoms, product usage, pregnancy/menarche/menopause/postpartum data, ...) for every configured profile — for backup purposes, not just one profile's cycle-start dates like export_history. The calendar-feed token is intentionally left out of the export for security.

filename.name: Filename
filename.description: Base filename (without extension) to save under. A timestamped name is generated automatically when left empty.

import_cycle_history.name: Import cycle history (from another app)
import_cycle_history.description: Additively imports cycle-start dates — unlike set_cycle_history, existing history is kept, not replaced. Tolerates ISO (YYYY-MM-DD) and dotted (DD.MM.YYYY) dates automatically; slash-separated dates are only parsed when date_format is explicitly set, since day-first vs. month-first is otherwise ambiguous. Dates that can't be parsed are skipped and reported back rather than aborting the import.

dates.name: Dates
dates.description: List of date strings to import, in ISO, dotted, or (with date_format set) slash format.

date_format.name: Date format
date_format.description: How to interpret slash-separated dates: 'auto' (default) only accepts ISO/dotted dates, 'dmy' treats DD/MM/YYYY as day-first, 'mdy' treats MM/DD/YYYY as month-first.

import_symptom_history.name: Import symptom history (from another app)
import_symptom_history.description: Additively bulk-imports symptom entries — existing values for a date are never overwritten, only gaps are filled, and everything is saved once. Each entry is an object with a date plus the same fields as add_symptom; basal_temp is read in the profile's configured temperature unit. Entries that fail validation are skipped and reported back rather than aborting the import.

entries.name: Entries
entries.description: List of objects, each with a 'date' plus add_symptom fields (e.g. pain, mood, basal_temp).

date_format.name: Date format
date_format.description: How to interpret slash-separated dates: 'auto' (default) only accepts ISO/dotted dates, 'dmy' treats DD/MM/YYYY as day-first, 'mdy' treats MM/DD/YYYY as month-first.

import_full_backup.name: Import full backup (all profiles)
import_full_backup.description: Restores data from a file previously written by export_full_backup. Only restores into profiles that are already configured (matched by profile slug) — never creates a new profile. Mode 'merge' (default) only fills in gaps and never overwrites data you already have; mode 'overwrite' fully replaces a matched profile's data with the backup's contents. Requires confirm: true.

filename.name: Filename
filename.description: Name of the backup file to read, from the menstruation_cycle_exports folder (without path).

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: 'merge' only fills in missing data without overwriting anything existing. 'overwrite' fully replaces a matched profile's data with the backup.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be set to true to confirm this write operation.

repair_storage.name: Repair/diagnose storage
repair_storage.description: Read-only diagnostic across every configured profile's stored data. Reports where normalization silently discarded or reset an invalid value (e.g. an out-of-range cycle_length_override, an unrecognized onboarding_stage or visibility_level, unparsable history/symptom/product-usage entries) as well as semantic inconsistencies (e.g. pregnancy_data marked active without a start_date, or pregnancy and menopause both active at once). Changes nothing.

send_test_notification.name: Send test notification
send_test_notification.description: Send a short test message to a profile's notification target to check that reminders arrive. Works even if notifications are switched off.

add_cycle_start.name: Add cycle start day
add_cycle_start.description: Add one confirmed bleeding day in YYYY-MM-DD format.

remove_cycle_start.name: Remove cycle start day
remove_cycle_start.description: Remove one confirmed bleeding day in YYYY-MM-DD format.

set_cycle_history.name: Replace full cycle history
set_cycle_history.description: Replace complete confirmed bleeding history with a list of dates.

dates.name: Dates
dates.description: List of bleeding-day dates in YYYY-MM-DD format.

set_period_duration.name: Set period duration days
set_period_duration.description: Set forecasted period duration (used for card markers).

erase_all_history.name: Erase all cycle history
erase_all_history.description: Destructive action. Deletes the complete stored history. Safety checks: - works only when `erase_all` is exactly `true` - requires explicit `entity_id` (sensor id) This helps prevent accidental destructive calls (e.g. shell command without target).

erase_all.name: Erase all
erase_all.description: Must be exactly true to confirm the deletion.

export_history.name: Export cycle history
export_history.description: Exports the current history to a local file. Files are written to `/config/menstruation_cycle_exports/`. Supported formats: `csv`, `txt`.

format.name: Format
format.description: Export file format: csv or txt.

refresh_cycle_model.name: Refresh cycle model
refresh_cycle_model.description: Recalculate all date-based sensor values, including days until next predicted start.

manage_household_inventory.name: Manage household inventory
manage_household_inventory.description: Manage shared household stock for tampons, pads, cups, liners, and period underwear.

inventory_action.name: Inventory action
inventory_action.description: What to do with the stock: set, add, consume, set_thresholds, add_to_shopping_list, reset, set_area_tracking.

warning_threshold.name: Warning threshold
warning_threshold.description: Stock level at which a warning is shown.

critical_threshold.name: Critical threshold
critical_threshold.description: Stock level at which the stock counts as critical.

member.name: Member
member.description: Household member the stock belongs to.

underwear_total_owned.name: Underwear owned
underwear_total_owned.description: Total number of period underwear pieces owned.

area_id.name: Area
area_id.description: Home Assistant area the stock or usage belongs to.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn household inventory tracking on or off.

add_symptom.name: Add or update symptom data for a date
add_symptom.description: Add or update symptom data for a specific date. Data is merged with existing entries.

symptom_data.name: Symptom data
symptom_data.description: Symptom values to store for the date.

remove_symptom.name: Remove symptom data for a date
remove_symptom.description: Remove all symptom data for a specific date.

get_symptom.name: Get symptom data for a date
get_symptom.description: Retrieve symptom data for a specific date.

compare_current_cycle.name: Compare current cycle
compare_current_cycle.description: Compares the current, still-ongoing cycle against the recent average (last up to 7 completed cycles): how many days it has run so far relative to the average cycle length, and how many pain days have been logged so far compared to the average pain days per completed cycle. Read-only, changes nothing.

get_last_cycle_summary.name: Get last cycle summary
get_last_cycle_summary.description: Returns a summary of the last completed cycle (between the two newest cycle starts): cycle length compared with the average of the cycles before, period days, pain days, logged days, the most frequent symptoms and the bleeding-strength distribution. Read-only, changes nothing.

confirm_contraception_renewal.name: Confirm contraception renewal
confirm_contraception_renewal.description: Records that the current contraception method was renewed (IUD, implant, injection) or that a new patch or ring pack was started, so the renewal period or the patch/ring rhythm counts from that date. Without a date, today is used.

date.name: Date
date.description: Day of the renewal or of the new pack (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

create_periods_from_bleeding.name: Create periods from bleeding
create_periods_from_bleeding.description: Adds period days for logged bleeding that never became a period. Bleeding within 14 days after a period day counts as intermenstrual bleeding and is not turned into a period. Returns the added dates.

set_pregnancy_mode.name: Set pregnancy mode
set_pregnancy_mode.description: Enable or disable pregnancy mode. When enabled, the sensor reports pregnancy state with weeks pregnant and due date.

is_pregnant.name: Pregnant
is_pregnant.description: Turn pregnancy mode on or off.

pregnancy_start_date.name: Pregnancy start date
pregnancy_start_date.description: First day of the last menstrual period.

update_pregnancy_date.name: Update pregnancy start date
update_pregnancy_date.description: Update the first day of the last menstrual period used for pregnancy calculations.

pregnancy_start_date.name: Pregnancy start date
pregnancy_start_date.description: First day of the last menstrual period.

set_menarche_mode.name: Set menarche mode
set_menarche_mode.description: Enable pre-menarche tracking or confirm that menarche has occurred. Use this for tracking puberty signs before the first period.

is_menarche.name: Menarche occurred
is_menarche.description: Whether the first period has already occurred.

estimated_menarche_date.name: Estimated menarche date
estimated_menarche_date.description: Expected date of the first period.

family_menarche_age.name: Family menarche age
family_menarche_age.description: Age at which close family members had their first period.

update_menarche_date.name: Update menarche date
update_menarche_date.description: Record the actual date when menarche (first period) occurred.

log_first_period.name: Log first period
log_first_period.description: Atomically records menarche date and adds the first cycle start. Use this to transition a profile out of Pre-Menarche mode when the first period begins.

get_menarche_info.name: Get menarche information
get_menarche_info.description: Retrieve menarche and pre-menarche tracking data for a profile.

add_pre_menarche_sign.name: Add pre-menarche body sign
add_pre_menarche_sign.description: Record or update a puberty body sign for pre-menarche tracking (Tanner stage classification).

tanner_stage.name: Tanner stage
tanner_stage.description: Tanner stage of the sign, for example stage_2.

remove_pre_menarche_sign.name: Remove pre-menarche body sign
remove_pre_menarche_sign.description: Remove a recorded puberty body sign from pre-menarche tracking.

set_menopause_mode.name: Set menopause mode
set_menopause_mode.description: Enable or disable menopause tracking mode.

is_menopause.name: Menopause
is_menopause.description: Turn menopause tracking mode on or off.

save_timer_state.name: Save timer state
save_timer_state.description: Persist the current countdown timer state (remaining time, selected product, running/paused) so it survives page reloads and is available on other devices. Called automatically by the Period Countdown Timer card.

total_seconds.name: Total seconds
total_seconds.description: Total duration of the timer in seconds.

selected_product.name: Selected product
selected_product.description: Product the timer is used for.

is_running.name: Running
is_running.description: Whether the timer is running (true) or paused (false).

saved_at.name: Saved at
saved_at.description: Time of saving as a millisecond timestamp.

export_doctor_report.name: Export doctor report (HTML)
export_doctor_report.description: Generates a professional HTML medical report from the cycle history and symptom data. The file is saved to `/config/menstruation_cycle_exports/`. Open the file in a browser and use "Print to PDF" to create a PDF.

days_back.name: Days back
days_back.description: How many days back the report covers.

patient_birthdate.name: Patient birth date
patient_birthdate.description: Birth date shown on the report.

set_profile_visibility.name: Set profile visibility
set_profile_visibility.description: Set how much of this profile's cycle/symptom data appears in its sensor attributes (dashboard cards, and the "at a glance" overview in companion apps). "full" shows everything as before. "status_only" reduces it to forecast-only values (next predicted start, average cycle length, period duration) - no symptom, mood, contraception, pregnancy or menarche details. "private" hides everything except that the profile exists. Note: this only affects the sensor's passive/at-a-glance attributes, not services like get_full_history/get_cycle_predictions that are called deliberately by whoever has access to this integration.

get_household_summary.name: Get household summary
get_household_summary.description: Read-only one-glance overview across every currently loaded profile (e.g. how many profiles are currently in their period, or fertile, right now). Respects each profile's visibility_level — a profile set to "private" contributes only to the total profile count, with its own entry showing no more than that it exists.

get_dashboard_prefs.name: Get dashboard prefs
get_dashboard_prefs.description: Internal: read back the signed-in person's saved dashboard widget/category settings (visibility, order) for a profile, so the Lovelace dashboard panel stays in sync across browsers/devices instead of being stuck to one browser's localStorage. Not meant to be called from automations.

save_dashboard_prefs.name: Save dashboard prefs
save_dashboard_prefs.description: Internal: persist the signed-in person's dashboard widget/category settings (visibility, order) for a profile. Not meant to be called from automations.

prefs.name: Preferences
prefs.description: Dashboard preferences (widget order and visibility) as an object.

confirm.title: Complete the migration
confirm.description:
The **{old_domain}** integration has been renamed to **{new_domain}**.

Profile: **{entry_title}**

Sensor data and history are kept. Select **Submit** to complete the migration.

rename_entities.title: Menstruation Cycle: Entity ID naming update available

confirm.title: Update entity names
confirm.description:
Profile: **{entry_title}**

These entities still use an older ID scheme from before this integration started prefixing entity IDs with `menstruation_` for easier searching:

{renames_list}

Renaming keeps all history and statistics, but **dashboards, automations or scripts that reference an old entity ID have to be updated manually** afterwards. Select **Submit** to rename them, or close this dialog to keep the current IDs.

stale_ics_token.title: Menstruation Cycle: Calendar feed token hasn't been rotated in a while

confirm.title: Create a new calendar feed token
confirm.description:
Profile: **{entry_title}**

The calendar subscription (ICS) URL of this profile still uses a token that has not been rotated for a long time. Anyone who ever had that URL (an old device, a shared calendar, a screenshot, ...) can still read this profile's predictions, because the feed has no separate login. Select **Submit** to create a new token: existing calendar subscriptions stop working and have to be set up again with the new URL. Or close this dialog to keep the current token.

low_prediction_confidence.title: Menstruation Cycle: Predictions are still low-confidence
low_prediction_confidence.description:
Profile: **{entry_title}**

This profile has {valid_cycles} of the {min_valid_cycles} recent cycles needed for high-precision predictions - fertile window and ovulation dates are still rough estimates. This isn't an error, just a normal part of getting started: predictions automatically become more precise the more cycles you log. No action needed here; dismiss this issue if you'd rather not see it while you're still building up history.

hospital_bag_incomplete.title: Menstruation Cycle: Hospital bag checklist still has open items
hospital_bag_incomplete.description:
Profile: **{entry_title}**

The due date ({due_date}) is about {days_until_due} day(s) away and the hospital bag checklist still has {remaining_items} item(s) left unchecked. No action is taken automatically - open the **Hospital bag checklist** todo list to review or check off items, or dismiss this issue if you're already on top of it.

pregnancy_overdue.title: Menstruation Cycle: Pregnancy mode is still active after the due date
pregnancy_overdue.description:
Profile: **{entry_title}**

The due date ({due_date}) was {days_overdue} day(s) ago, but pregnancy mode is still switched on, so the week counter keeps growing. No action is taken automatically - if the pregnancy has ended or the baby has arrived, turn pregnancy mode off with the **set_pregnancy_mode** service (or start the postpartum phase); if the due date was entered wrongly, correct it with **update_pregnancy_date**. Dismiss this issue if everything is as it should be.

storage_integrity.title: Menstruation Cycle: Storage integrity findings
storage_integrity.description:
Profile: **{entry_title}**

The repair_storage diagnostic found {issue_count} finding(s) for this profile, e.g.: {first_issue}. This ranges from harmless (a value normalization already corrected) to worth a closer look - call the **repair_storage** service for the full list per profile. No action is taken automatically; dismiss this issue once you've reviewed it or it no longer applies.

household_inventory_critical.title: Menstruation Cycle: Household supplies running low
household_inventory_critical.description: The following products are at or below their critical stock level: **{products_list}**. They were already added to the Home Assistant shopping list when they first hit the warning threshold - this additional notice means stock is now critically low. Restock soon, or adjust the critical threshold via the **manage_household_inventory** service if this doesn't match your actual usage. Dismiss this issue once you've restocked.

low_wellness_score.title: Menstruation Cycle: Wellness score is low
low_wellness_score.description:
Profile: **{entry_title}**

This profile's wellness score is currently {score}/100 - it combines cycle regularity, recent pain days, and how much history backs it. This is purely informational, not medical advice, and no action is taken automatically. If this persists, it may be worth reviewing recent symptom patterns or discussing them with a doctor. Dismiss this issue if you're already aware.

profile_inactive.title: Menstruation Cycle: Profile has been inactive
profile_inactive.description:
Profile: **{entry_title}**

This profile hasn't had a new cycle entry or symptom log in {days_inactive} day(s). This is purely informational and no action is taken automatically - log a new entry if tracking is still active, or dismiss this issue if the profile is intentionally on pause.

cycle_pattern_risk.title: Menstruation Cycle: Cycle pattern worth discussing with a doctor
cycle_pattern_risk.description:
Profile: **{entry_title}**

This profile's logged data shows irregular cycles (cycle length varies by about {cycle_std_days} days) and/or frequent pain days (about {avg_pain_days_per_cycle} pain days per cycle on average). These are patterns sometimes associated with conditions like PCOS or endometriosis - this is NOT a diagnosis, just an informational pattern match, and no action is taken automatically. If this persists, it may be worth mentioning to a doctor. Dismiss this issue if you're already aware.

period_overdue.title: Menstruation Cycle: Period is overdue
period_overdue.description:
Profile: **{entry_title}**

The predicted period start for this profile passed {days_overdue} day(s) ago and no new cycle start has been logged. Cycles can be late for many reasons (stress, travel, illness, hormonal changes, pregnancy), and predictions are only estimates. This is purely informational, not medical advice, and no action is taken automatically. If a pregnancy is possible, a test can bring clarity, and if this keeps happening it may be worth discussing with a doctor. Log the start once your period begins, or dismiss this issue if you're already aware.

period_prolonged.title: Menstruation Cycle: Period is lasting unusually long
period_prolonged.description:
Profile: **{entry_title}**

Bleeding has been logged for {days} days in a row, which is longer than usual for this profile. A period lasting more than about a week can have many causes, and this is purely informational, not medical advice - no action is taken automatically. If the bleeding is very heavy or keeps going, it may be worth discussing with a doctor. Dismiss this issue if you're already aware.

checkup_overdue.title: Menstruation Cycle: Routine checkup may be due
checkup_overdue.description:
Profile: **{entry_title}**

The last gynecological checkup logged for this profile was on {last_date}, about {months} months ago. This reminder is set to {interval} months in the options; the right interval depends on age, history and local recommendations. This is purely informational, not medical advice, and no action is taken automatically. Log your next appointment once it has happened, or dismiss this issue if you're already aware.

notify_target_unavailable.title: Menstruation Cycle: Notifications cannot be delivered
notify_target_unavailable.description:
Profile: **{entry_title}**

The notify target `{target}` does not exist or the last attempt to use it failed, so reminders for this profile are not arriving. Check the notify service in this profile's options (for example `mobile_app_myphone`). This issue disappears by itself once a notification has been delivered successfully.
